blocks.text: Interior design for apartments and houses in Bratislava

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN is an interior design studio in Bratislava. Our office and furniture production facility are located in the Ružinov district, and renovation and installation are carried out by our own crews. We design apartments, houses, and residences and deliver them turnkey: from the first consultation to handing over the keys.

Completed projects in Bratislava include apartments in Metropolis and Eurovea City, a 158 m² duplex apartment, and a 120 m² private house. Every project is developed individually — around the layout, the lighting, the owners’ lifestyle, and the budget.

items: Layout and zoning — layout options with furniture placement and lighting scenarios.
Interior concept — style, color scheme, finishing materials, furniture, lighting, textiles, and decor.
3D visualization — photorealistic images of every room.
Technical documentation — measured floor plan, demolition and construction plans, electrical, plumbing, floors, ceilings, wall elevations, and specifications.
Custom furniture — production drawings for kitchens, wardrobes, walk-in closets, and built-in storage systems.
Procurement and design supervision — selecting and ordering materials, and checking that the renovation matches the project.

parts.html: The scope of the project depends on the package you choose: from “Express” with a layout and visualizations to “Premium+” with a full set of documentation and support through to the handover of the property.

blocks.text: Interior design project prices in Bratislava

parts.html: Design project prices depend on the scope of work: the “Express” package — €20/m², “Basic” — €35–45/m², “Furniture” — €35–50/m², “Premium” — €50/m², “Premium+” — €70/m². The first consultation is free.

Renovation and furniture costs are calculated based on the project. For the renovation, we prepare a detailed cost estimate — €5/m²; if you order the renovation from us, its cost is deducted from the contract amount.

blocks.text: Questions about interior design in Bratislava

items.q: How much does an apartment interior design project cost in Bratislava?
items.a: From €20/m² for the “Express” package to €70/m² for “Premium+”. For a 60 m² apartment, a full project under the “Basic” package comes to €2,100–2,700. The minimum project price is €1,500. See the prices page for details.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: “Express” — from 14 days after the layout is approved. A full project with technical documentation usually takes 4–8 weeks, depending on the floor area and the number of revisions.

items.q: Do you carry out the renovation based on your own project?
items.a: Yes. Our crews carry out the renovation, we make the furniture at our own production facility in Bratislava, and we take care of procurement and design supervision. You can also order just the project.

items.q: Do you work with apartments bought from a developer?
items.a: Yes, most of our projects in Bratislava are new builds with a basic finish or none at all. We also carry out an apartment handover inspection before you sign the handover certificate.

items.q: Where is the studio, and can I visit?
items.a: Súkennícka 1, Bratislava-Ružinov — the studio on Google Maps. Visit us by appointment: we will show you material and hardware samples and discuss your project.
Yes — throughout Slovakia, in Vienna and Lower Austria, and remotely: we have completed projects in Prague, Munich, Berlin, Warsaw, Kraków, and other cities.
